text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo has offered to give Kawakami Princess a dance lesson, and I join them as an observer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now then, King, I'm ready to begin today's dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, well. Wasn't that a proper bow? I wonder if that form will translate into your dancing. So, let's—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: GET THIS STARTED!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Humph! Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hold it right there! What in the world are you doing?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What am I doing? Well, this is a dance lesson, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You told me that the key to beautiful dancing is mustering enough physical strength to maintain your posture, remember? ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, for the… If you're not even fooling around, that just makes it harder to scold you for it!
choice_data_list: At the very least, let's stop with the punches.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: P-precisely! You're aware that dancing isn't about hitting people, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?! B-but then what should I be doing?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, I get it! It's about leg strength rather than arm strength! So kicks instead of punches!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, you dolt! No kicking! Only steps!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Steps! Like this?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're still lacking! If your aim is to be a first-rate dancer, you must focus on every detail of your movements, down to the tips of your toes!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Understood! I'll step hard enough to break through the floorboards! Humph! Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the instruction of her strict teacher, Kawakami Princess's dancing becomes even more extraordinary!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a great idea! King Halo enchants me with her dancing every time I see it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't just watch! Come now, you dance too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Wooow! I actually get to dance together with King!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump! Thwack!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait… Stop! Stooop!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You're being way too aggressive. This is no different from when you were throwing punches every which where!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Really? That's weird… I'm only trying to dance as usual.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just… watch how you're moving! You'd better not even think about hitting me, understand?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I'd never do something like that! So please don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After more practice, Kawakami Princess manages to further hone her dancing skills thanks to King Halo's careful instruction.
